Argentum Iodatum.

Iodide of Silver. Ag I. Trituration.

Clinical.─Catarrh. Hoarseness. Paralysis. Syphilis.

Characteristics.─Hale has suggested Arg. iod. as a remedy in conditions presenting symptoms of both the components. In practice he found it of great value in disorders of the throat, pharynx, larynx, and bronchia; in some peculiar mental disorders; glandular affections; catarrhs, and affections of the heart.
